capabilities: Sync frontmatter tags, links and dates with the folder a note lives in
Create and update an index note per folder listing its subfolders and notes
Update properties automatically on create, modify, rename and save
Rename files and folders to remove spaces while keeping links intact
Skip hidden folders and user-listed names during vault-wide updates
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian does not keep frontmatter properties or per-folder index notes up to date when notes are created, moved or renamed, so folder context must be maintained by hand.
summary: Folder-driven properties manager that syncs frontmatter tags, links and dates with the folder structure and creates index notes for each folder.
